content_sections.heading: NIT Kurukshetra Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NIT Kurukshetra Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download NIT Kurukshetra Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer (Civil): B.E. / B.Tech. in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute or First Class Diploma in Civil Engineering with excellent academic record. Junior Engineer (Electrical): B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute or First Class Diploma in Electrical Engineering with excellent academic record.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Kurukshetra Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Engineer posts at NIT Kurukshetra is scheduled for 24th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E. / B.Tech. in the relevant Engineering discipline or a First Class Diploma in the relevant Engineering with an excellent academic record to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Junior Engineer position at NIT Kurukshetra, with 3 posts for Civil and 1 post for Electrical.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Junior Engineer posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Engineer posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,640/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra, Haryana, Pin Code: 136119.
